final: WITH filtered_fees AS (SELECT f.orderslink, f.feerate, f.rebrate, o.dealedge FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009), group_stats AS (SELECT orderslink, dealedge, AVG(feerate - rebrate) as group_avg_net_fee, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM filtered_fees GROUP BY orderslink, dealedge), side_averages AS (SELECT dealedge, AVG(group_avg_net_fee) as side_avg FROM group_stats GROUP BY dealedge) SELECT gs.orderslink, gs.dealedge as side, gs.group_avg_net_fee, gs.record_count, gs.group_avg_net_fee - sa.side_avg as difference FROM group_stats gs JOIN side_averages sa ON gs.dealedge = sa.dealedge WHERE gs.group_avg_net_fee > sa.side_avg ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
